title: Lut Layi Paak Zainab Di Musalamana Rida
body:
Turpayi Aey Shaam De Val Bekafan Chad Ke Bhira.
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj Karan Gi Veer Teray, Khoon Di Tabligh Mai
Hashr Tak Duniya Karay Gi, Tera Matam Har Jaga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Vekhiya Jis Nay Bahathar, Lasha Tapdhi Rait Te
Kyon Na Rovay Sain Zainab, Jis Da Koi Na Reya.
<<DIVIDER>>
Thalia Mal Mal Ke Jagandi, Reya Mai Sajaad Nu
Veer Ponchiya Jadou Me, Shaam De Vich Berida.
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj Karan Gi Veer Teray, Khoon Dhi Tableegh Mai
Hashr Tak Duniya Karay Gi, Tera Matam Har Jaga.
<<DIVIDER>>
Bekafan Saray Bhira Nay, Berida Bhena Day Sir
Ghazi Teray Bajou Lutgayi, Vekh Enjh Alay Aba.
<<DIVIDER>>
Enj Hassan Farwa De Chan Nu, Mariya Ay Zalima
Dair Thak Qasim Dhi Sayed, Lasha Nu Labdha Reya.
